newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Most Estonia stocks rebound, no clear trend seen.
newsitem.headline: Most Estonia stocks rebound, no clear trend seen.

text.p: Trade was quiet on Friday on the stock exchange with most banks stable to slightly higher.
The Talse rose slightly by 0.21 percent to close on 272.62 kroons with 47.4 million kroons traded on the main list.
Total market capitalisation was higher at 14.6 billion kroons compared to Thursday's 14.5 billion kroons.
"The day's trade was not very busy but for the volumes the prices of stock fluctuated too much," one dealer said.
"The main issue on the Estonia bourse is that local investors think that all small drops will be followed by a strong rise and it is local investors who are making the market at present," he said.
Leading bank Hansapank turned over 22.7 million kroons and was stable to close on 143.50 kroons while Hoiupank saw trade of 8.6 million kroons to firm to 131.40 kroons, a gain of 1.40.
"There is still an expectation about this stock and some investors feel it will be the next to move higher," another dealer said.
Tallinna Pank was 1.50 kroons lower on 75.50 kroons against 77.00 kroons. The city of Tallinn confirmed today it was to sell its seven percent stake in the bank.
"Tallinna was within its range and the news about the share sale by the city did not really move it far. Even if the city sold at 65 kroons, it would not cause a sell off," he added.
"The bigger question is who will buy the stake," he added.
On the over-the-counter market, total trade was 10.9 million kroons of shares with Rakvere meat plant the most traded stock by far.
Rakvere turned over 8.1 million kroons to close 0.30 kroons higher on 16.05 kroons.
"There were some bigger blocks traded in Rakvere this morning, but the following trade seems more speculative," a trader said.
